title: List Page - Verify Pagination functionality on Column Configuration – List Page.
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page

steps.action: Now change the record per page count
steps.expectedResult: Based on the pagination grid should be updated
User should be redirect to the next page
User should be redirect to the previous page.
